Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions (applicable for all items):

1. Three (3) sets of Operation and Maintenance Manual and Parts Catalogue sh all be supplied at free of cost along with the equipment. 2. Commissioning: Installation, Commissioning & trial run/demonstration of For klift with training of operator at site shall be done by Manufacturer’s service en gineer. 3. Load Test certificate to be furnished along with equipment. 4. OPERATIONAL & SERVICE SPARES (CONSUMABLES) Following spares to be supplied per no. of forklift: Service kit suitable for 4 Services shall be in vendor scope. Additionally, 2 Kg DCP fire extinguisher to be supplied per forklift. 5. Test Certificate, Warranty/ Guarantee Certificate to be submitted by the Ven dor along with material supply. The guarantee/Warranty shall be 18 months fro m date of supply or 12 months from date of commissioning of the machine, whi chever is earlier. Within this warranty / guarantee period free replacement of S pares Fittings/mountings/safety & other items shall be ensured for any type of manufacturing defect found. 6. The party shall submit performance bank guarantee 5% of the ordered value against any manufacturing defect, poor workmanship, poor performance etc fo r warranty period. 7. Temporary registration and Vehicle comprehensive Insurance Charges for 1 year shall be borne by the vendor. Final / Permanent registration shall be in sc ope of NTPC; however, vendor shall provide all required documents for Final / P ermanent registration of vehicle. (registration not applicable in case of battery- operated forklifts) 8. Long Text of material to be referred for final Technical Specification. 9. Toolkit shall be supplied along with Forklift. 10. Type Approval Certificate from ARAI or any government approved agency f or Forklift should comply with Government of India latest smoke emission norm s (in case of diesel operated forklifts). STANDARD TC / INSPECTION REPORT REQUIREMENT: Performance testing including load testing: As per Tender/PO specs/NTPC approved Drg/DS/relevant stand ard / Manufacturer’s Standard. Notes :- 1. NTPC reserves the right to cross check the test values at vendor’s works / Third party lab / NTPC site. 2. Vendor to ensure traceability of the Test Certificate (TC ) / Inspection report (IR) with the item being man ufactured. 3. TC / IR shall be from manufacturer’s own lab or a NABL accredited lab or any third-party lab accredited as per ISO / IEC 17025.
